basics.name: Arash Azma
basics.label: Computer Engineer
basics.summary: Computer Engineer (B.Sc.) with strong experience in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Large Language Models (LLMs), Speech Processing, and Software Development. Experienced in developing AI-driven applications using PyTorch, Hugging Face, and modern deep learning frameworks. Demonstrated success in academic research, teaching, and industry projects, including robotics perception, speech recognition systems, and scalable mobile applications. Seeking a graduate opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge research and innovation in AI, robotics, and computer engineering.

work.summary: Persian speech recognition, LLM fine-tuning, and end-to-end voice assistant development.
highlights: Develop a high-performance Persian STT system using PyTorch and distributed fine-tuning across 3 GPUs, reducing CER from 0.28 to 0.025; open-source the resulting Whisper models on Hugging Face (1,200+ monthly downloads), and release an accompanying benchmark dataset and leaderboard for reproducible Persian ASR evaluation.
Design and implement an automated audio annotation pipeline leveraging ensembles of open-source AI models, curating over 5,000 hours of high-quality speech data.

Fine-tune Qwen and Gemma large language models (LLMs) for intent detection and slot-filling in conversational AI systems, improving domain-specific intent classification accuracy by 18% (achieving a 0.94 F1-score).

Design and deploy an end-to-end voice assistant by integrating STT, LLM, and TTS modules with Node-RED-orchestrated AI agent workflows, enabling natural language requests to be translated into structured report-generation queries and dynamically executed multi-step workflows.

work.summary: Visual odometry and attention-module research within the Visual Odometry group.
highlights: Developed an end-to-end VO pipeline utilizing feature extraction algorithms (SIFT and ORB) paired with Perspective-n-Point (PnP) for precise 3D-to-2D pose tracking.
Evaluated and benchmarked model performance using the KITTI autonomous driving vision dataset.
Researching and developing a novel, plug-and-play convolutional attention module designed to enhance spatial and channel-wise feature representation across diverse vision backbones.

work.summary: Full-time developer on a high-traffic social media platform.
highlights: Engineered and scaled a high-traffic, production-grade social media platform (Twitter clone) using React Native, implementing an efficient UI/UX that successfully onboarded and served 100,000+ active users.

Optimized mobile application performance and overhauled state management architecture, resulting in a measurable reduction in app latency and a smoother multimedia handling experience across cross-platform devices.
Fast-tracked to a full-time developer role after a 3-month intensive internship due to key technical contributions to core architecture, feature deployment, and codebase scalability.

teaching.description: Design and assess coursework and assignments on Q-learning and policy-based reinforcement learning; facilitate RL tutorials and supervise undergraduate student projects; mentor students in implementing AI algorithms and debugging machine learning workflows.

Supervise projects focused on Support Vector Machines (SVMs) and Decision Tree algorithms; mentor students in implementing machine learning algorithms from scratch and using industry-standard libraries.

Provided academic instruction and mentorship to more than 100 undergraduate students in C programming; delivered technical guidance on pointers, memory management, and algorithmic problem-solving; facilitated laboratory sessions and evaluated programming assignments.
